title: Allum
description: Nostalgic Trip Back to the Classic Era of Minecraft Modpacks
body:
**Remember that _unique_ feeling of booting up a modded Minecraft world for the very first time?**

  **We've recreated it in**

  
![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/890b8fb57df51ff0f36a33b6053c388059a10f51.png)

> Experience the gritty textures, intricate progression, and adventurous spirit of the past, now merged with new minecraft things.

What's in the **box**?

- Two generation variations: Overhauled, Beautiful with Huge Caves and Entire Underground Villages, and Older One, but still improved generation.
- Farmer's Delight with some Addons, retro-fied with resourcepack
- Programming with CC:Tweaked
- Extra Alchemy
- Improved Fishing, more immersive
- Improved Horses and interaction with them
- Illager Expansion
- Backpacks from Inmis Mod - best beta-like backpacks
- Shaders, if u want them
- Joy of Painting and Immersive Melodies
- Map? Draw it yourself
- Mutant Monsters and Musket Mod to fight them with
- Better Trials
- Create? Too modern-like. So, we found PolyFactory!
- Serene Seasons
- Want some magic? Try Trickster! (try learn it)
- The real Classic - Aether Mod
- Boring Villagers? How about a REALLY alive villagers? Here's MCA Mod!
- ... and many, many, many, more mods
